topic: The article inside a proper name
claim: Definite reference is taken to exclude an indefinite determiner in a proper name.
evidence_summary: A Flock of Seagulls names a single band and occurs as subject in BMG’s prose.
finding: Distinguish a fixed article inside a conventional name from productive external determination.
inference: Does definite reference constrain which article can be fixed inside a name?

evidence.source: BMG (12 March 2026). BMG Acquires Publishing & Recording Catalog of A Flock of Seagulls.
evidence.passage: §20.2.1, p. 517. Definite reference is taken to exclude an indefinite determiner in a proper name.
evidence.example: BMG uses the full band name A Flock of Seagulls in subject position, referring to the one band.
evidence.establishes: An indefinite article is fixed inside this conventional name. This leaves open what external determination it allows.
evidence.locator: Fifth body paragraph, beginning Formed in Liverpool in 1979.
